hooks.text: 每翻开一张安全牌，金币收益指数增长；可随时兑现，也可继续冒险并在踩雷时清空本轮收益
hooks.excerpt: Use numbered diamonds to deduce mine locations, but instead of just clearing the board, each safe card you reveal exponentially increases your coin winnings. Decide when to cash out and secure your earnings, or push your luck for massive payouts - hit a mine and lose everything you've earned that round.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 六十种强化可把地雷变收益、揭示危险、抵消失误或放大倍数，并能继续组合协同
hooks.excerpt: 60 unique power-ups that change your strategy each run: Risk/reward modifiers like High Roller and Golden Touch turn mines into profit opportunities, Powerups like Fortune Teller and Lucky Peak reveal hidden dangers, Shield and Armor Plating protect you from mistakes, and multiplier boosters like Lucky Charm and Coin Magnet maximize your earnings. Combine power-ups to create devastating synergies and develop new strategies every playthrough.

hooks.text: 局间随机商店与永久解锁构成成长层，动态Joker还会改写兑现倍率
hooks.excerpt: Roguelike progression with randomized shops between rounds Meta-progression system: unlock permanent upgrades between runs Dynamic Joker cards that modify your cashout multiplier
